name: CraneMath
intro: CraneMath 是 Olmo 3 第二阶段仅用于训练的中期训练语料，不是独立评测集。官方配方对 FineMath4+ 的 6,699,493 个 train 样本逐条用 SwallowMath 提示和 Qwen3-32B 重写一次，移除生成失败后得到 6,553,181 个文档、5.625B tokens；MATH/GSM8K 数值是数据效用消融。
build_method: 对 FineMath4+ train 的每个样本使用 SwallowMath 公开提示和 Qwen3-32B 独立重写一次，移除生成失败项，形成仅训练用的许可更宽松合成数学语料；未披露专属人工审核、去重或验证器
metric: 数据消融：原始提升 MATH +18.5、GSM8K +27.4；表 41 归一化 Δ=(退火分数−退火前分数)/目标 tokens 数(B)，对应 4.26 与 6.32；不是逐题准确率
eval_feature: 以 6T-token 基础模型做 50% 网页、50% 候选源 microanneal，对比 MATH、GSM8K 与 MMLU 变化
scale: 官方 train：6,553,181 个文档、5.625B tokens；论文源池：5.62B tokens、6.55M 文档；100B 混合：5.62B tokens（5.63%）、7.24M 文档
build_method_en: Rewrite each FineMath4+ train example once with the published SwallowMath prompt and Qwen3-32B, remove generation failures, and publish a train-only permissively generated math corpus; no dedicated manual review, deduplication or verifier is disclosed
eval_feature_en: Run 50% web/50% candidate-source microanneals from a 6T-token base model and compare MATH, GSM8K and MMLU changes
intro_en: CraneMath is train-only Olmo 3 Stage-2 midtraining data, not a standalone evaluation set. The official recipe rewrites each of 6,699,493 FineMath4+ train examples once with the SwallowMath prompt and Qwen3-32B; after generation failures are removed, 6,553,181 documents and 5.625B tokens remain. Its MATH/GSM8K values are data-utility ablations.
scale_en: Official train: 6,553,181 documents and 5.625B tokens; paper source pool: 5.62B tokens and 6.55M documents; 100B mix: 5.62B tokens (5.63%) and 7.24M documents
metric_en: Data ablation: raw lift MATH +18.5 and GSM8K +27.4; Table 41 normalized Δ=(anneal score−pre-anneal score)/target tokens seen (B), giving 4.26 and 6.32; not item accuracy

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Olmo 3 arXiv:2512.13961v2 §3.5 and §A.3.1; fixed sources are allenai/dolma3 full commit 1a9daced81670e0fa768e47fbed32af6694a1865, dolma3_dolmino_pool revision 091589c58ab6acc180d71017ecea8201776f05b2, FineMath revision e92b25a616738fe95dc186b64dfb19f9c8525594, 7B mix revision f23942ae8a8114af6e992efe8188ce8c531acd16, and 32B mix revision f23aa129fda8335ba9760057bcc1f0c02f3d068b. The official recipe rewrites 6,699,493 FineMath4+ train examples once with the SwallowMath prompt and Qwen3-32B; dropping generation failures yields 6,553,181 documents and 5.625B tokens. It discloses no dedicated CraneMath manual review, deduplication, eval split, self-correction, or verifier. Paper Table 5 separately reports a 5.62B-token/6.55M-document source pool and a 100B mix containing 5.62B tokens (5.63%) and 7.24M documents. The main text raw lifts are MATH 18.5 and GSM8K 27.4; Table 41 normalizes by target tokens seen and reports 4.26 and 6.32 for 4.34B tokens. These are training-data utility ablations, not CraneMath item accuracy.
